adjudication.reason: The current taker rebate materially improves the retained NegRisk state but does not create a queue-free edge. At five and twenty shares, the all-taker path requires a 58.6161231584% rebate to break even before external costs, above the documented maximum 50% Obsidian tier. The maker-input path improves at an effective tier, but still requires an owned passive Bitcoin NO fill followed by conversion and executable output sales. Exact wallet eligibility, completed tier activation, conversion access, pUSD-versus-USDT costs, post-fill books, latency, adverse selection, and after-cost profit remain unproved.
